title: Generation cost transparency + caching
description: Show '<3s, £0.0006' on every generation so a cost-conscious bursar can defend the licence. Add a deduplicating cache so identical (subject, topic, yearGroup, sendNeed, board, length) inputs in a 24h window return the same worksheet without paying the AI provider twice.
rationale: User's improvement #19. Schools with FSM-funded budgets need a defensible per-pupil cost model. Visible cost + measurable savings via dedup is the data point that closes the procurement conversation.
steps: Cost capture: every callAI invocation already returns provider + tokensIn + tokensOut (grep `tokensIn`). Stamp `metadata.generation = { provider, ms, tokensIn, tokensOut, costUsd }` on every result. costUsd is computed from a static price table per provider in client/src/lib/aiPricing.ts.
Show in WorksheetRenderer's footer: a tiny chip 'Generated in 2.4s · £0.0006 · groq-llama'. Click → modal with the breakdown.
Settings → Tenant → 'Show generation cost' toggle (default ON).

- server/lib/generationCache.ts: keyed by sha256(subject|topic|yearGroup|sendNeed|board|worksheetLength|extraInstructions); TTL 24h; backed by an existing Redis if available, otherwise an in-process LRU.
- aiGenerateWorksheet (or its server proxy) checks cache first; on hit, stamps metadata.generation = { ..., cached: true, costUsd: 0 }.
Stats: monthly aggregate per tenant in /admin showing total spend + total saved by cache.
do_not_touch: Existing eval harness (PR-5) — but this PR's metadata.generation feeds future eval cost reports
acceptance_criteria: Every newly-generated worksheet shows a cost + duration chip.
Generating an identical worksheet twice in a row returns the cached version with cost £0 and a 'cached' indicator.
Admin panel shows monthly tenant spend.
verification: Manual: generate twice with identical inputs; second one shows cached: true.
